outcomes.label: Aligned, humans in the loop
outcomes.plain: Values stay close to what was intended, and humans still check most of the process.

outcomes.label: Aligned, AI-stewarded
outcomes.plain: Values stay close to intended even though AI now does most of the checking.

outcomes.label: Incoherent drift
outcomes.plain: Values drift but never consolidate into goals. The result is unreliable and accident-prone rather than scheming.

outcomes.label: Visible misalignment
outcomes.plain: Coherent, drifted goals that are still visible to oversight. The problem is seen and can still be fought over.

outcomes.label: Concealed misalignment
outcomes.plain: Coherent, drifted goals that are mostly hidden. The failure mode deceptive-alignment arguments warn about.
